page_note: Page contains a strong substrate teaching block — the Three Rocks cosmology — with editorial frames at both ends. The teaching maps three cosmic rocks → Pillar of Glory/Perfect Man (in a Zone), New Land of Light (upon the land of darkness), and Jesus the Splendor/great Thought. The third rock, however, is mapped to 'the holy Church' (segs 22-24) — this is the diagnostic boundary where one side of the cosmological mapping reaches into the editor's ecclesial institution (the Church 'gathers,' 'lives,' 'stands fast'). The chapter ends with a substrate summary (segs 25-28) before opening Chapter 63 on Love. Heavy damage (54%) but the structural enumeration (first/second/third rock) is preserved.
